bifrost: bifrost_app::defaults, coding, file_coordination, fswatch, workspace, quicksearch, document; docbroker file grants
summary: Settings, JSON and plist coding, file coordination, change events and Spotlight-style indexing have SDK APIs. FileManager has an SDK type for item operations, atomic writes, replaceItemAt, standard user directories and option-driven enumeration. There is no FileWrapper, no keyed archiver or binary plist, and no iCloud.

features.feature: File System (create, read, write, examine files)
features.apple: FileManager, FileHandle, URL file APIs, FileWrapper, bookmarks
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/file_manager.rs (NativeFileManager: item operations, write_atomically, replace_item_at, url_for, enumerator); springboard/src/bare/docbroker.rs; docs/file-portal-design.md; springboard/sdk/src/document.rs; wired: springboard/apps/files/src/info.rs (get_info reads the item status for the panel)
features.note: FileManager item operations, Data-style atomic write, replaceItemAt with backup, standard directories and enumerator options are host unit-tested; no FileWrapper, and user files still go through the file portal grants. Not yet wired into apps; verify on Midget for parity.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/file_coordination.rs; wired: springboard/apps/files/src/ops.rs (transfer_now, compress_now, extract_now) via src/coordinate.rs (writing_in, refused)
features.note: Advisory flock; no relinquish or move negotiation, no versions. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 4 (0.5.41); verify on Midget for parity.
Recursive inotify stream with latency and a SHALLOW flag.
Recycle uses the shared Recently Deleted folder with Put Back.

features.feature: Archives and Serialization: JSON and property lists
features.note: JSON and XML plist only; no binary plist, Data unsupported, few strategies.

One restorable window per app, JSON file.
